newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on stronger dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on stronger dollar.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly firmer on Tuesday, as the yen's fall against the dollar fuelled moderate short-covering, Japanese traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 2.0 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark December closed 0.8 yen higher at 120.6 yen.
Today's rise was regarded as a technical correction after sharp falls in recent weeks, traders said. Rising rubber output in producing countries was cited as a bearish factor.
"Bearish sentiment remains intact. Investors will take advantage of any price rises to sell," one trader said.
